title: "03_augment"
format: html

##Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

expr_clean <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_expression.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata_clean <- read_tsv("../data/02_clean_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

##Transpose the expression dataframe so columns become entrez IDs and rows become samples, to match the format of the metadata
```{r}
expr_transposed <- expr_clean |>
  dplyr::select(-SYMBOL)  |>            #symbol column is dropped
  pivot_longer(-ENTREZ_ID, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "expr_clean") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = ENTREZ_ID, values_from = expr_clean)
```

##Inner join expression to meta dataset into a combined wide dataset
```{r}
dat_aug <- metadata_clean |> 
  inner_join(expr_transposed, by = "sample_id")

dim(dat_aug)
slice_sample(dat_aug, n=10)
```

##Enriching the joint dataset with new columns useful for descriptive statistics and visualization
```{r}
#Create a new "smoking_exposure" column that categorizes the samples based on the values in "smoking_pack_years" according to the classification proposed by Giuliano et al. (10.1001/jamaoto.2023.1573). These categories are then converted into an ordered factor.

dat_aug <- dat_aug |>
  mutate(
    smoking_exposure = case_when(
        smoking_pack_years == 0 ~ "Never smoker",
        smoking_pack_years > 0 & smoking_pack_years <= 20 ~ "Light smoker",
        smoking_pack_years > 20 & smoking_pack_years <= 40 ~ "Moderate smoker",
        smoking_pack_years > 40 ~ "Heavy smoker",
      )
  ) |> 
  relocate(smoking_exposure, .after = smoking_pack_years)
```


```{r}
# Create new columns regarding the progression status of the disease
dat_aug <- dat_aug |> 
  mutate(
    progression_status = case_when(
        outcome_group == "Group 1" ~ "Persistent",
        outcome_group == "Group 2" ~ "Regressive",
        outcome_group == "Group 3" ~ "Progressive",
        outcome_group == "Group 4" ~ "Stable non-dysplasia"
      )
  ) |> 
  relocate(progression_status, .after = outcome_group)
```

##Write the dat_aug into a tsv file
```{r}
write_tsv(dat_aug, here("data", "03_augmented_data.tsv"))
```
